changeSet.author: khrvacic
changeSet.comment: The case-insensitive alias lookup: domain_id = ? and lower(short_url) = lower(?), used by the create check, the public alias check and domain removal. Not unique, because older case pairs exist.
changeSet.sql: create index if not exists ix_url_domain_lower_short_url ON url (domain_id, lower(short_url))
